title: Find the four mistakes
description:
This program has four small mistakes of the kind every beginner makes. Use the compiler's messages to find and fix them all. It should print:

```
C++ is case-sensitive.
Every statement ends with a semicolon.
```
hints: Fix the first error in the list, build again, and repeat. One mistake often causes several messages.
The four mistakes: `Main` should be `main`, `cuot` should be `cout`, a `;` is missing, and the closing `}` of main is missing.

examples.name: prints both sentences
examples.expected:
C++ is case-sensitive.
Every statement ends with a semicolon.

tests.name: prints both sentences
tests.expected:

Every statement ends with a semicolon.
